title: DC-X Flight 8
summary: Footage of DC-X Flight 8 from July 1995 at White Sands, in which the Delta Clipper Experimental reusable rocket turned over into a re-entry profile and re-oriented itself for landing.
why: HN cites it as proof that vertical-landing reusable rockets were flown decades before SpaceX, including the same hover-slam landing.

quote.text: You can see at the end that the DC-X even does the same "hover slam" maneuver as Falcon 9
